title: Branch cleanup reconnect-safe progress delivery
intent: Running cargo test -p gwt --lib after implementation; headed E2E already PASS on dark + light
progress_summary: Implemented Issue #4433 end to end. Protocol: operation_id on RunBranchCleanup / RunWorkspaceCleanup / BranchCleanupProgress / BranchCleanupResult, plus new SyncBranchCleanup and ClearBranchCleanupStatus frontend events. Backend: cleanup progress and results now broadcast instead of replying to the originating client_id, and a BranchCleanupOperationStore keeps the latest snapshot per cleanup surface so a reconnected client can pull it back; the initial per-client sync also replays live operations for a reloaded page that lost its operation ids. Frontend: a mid-cleanup disconnect no longer renders a fake failure, the client re-syncs on reconnect, superseded operations are dropped, and closing the result releases the backend snapshot. Verified: 8 protocol tests, 8 reconnect tests, 16 frontend smoke tests, 37 frontend smoke suite, headed Chromium E2E PASS on dark and light with zero console/page errors, cargo clippy -p gwt --all-targets --all-features clean.
